title: Blood Resonance
next_chapter_hook: The voice of the Dragon Vein Guardian rang like an ancient bell, echoing deep within the bloodline. That low and majestic voice spoke: 'Chen family descendant, I have waited ten thousand years for you.'

text.content: The night was dark as ink, with cold stars scattered across the sky. Chen Ji sat cross-legged in the quiet chamber, before him lay a half volume of ancient texts stolen from the Tianqing Sect's scripture library, four characters clearly written on the cover—'Dragon Vein Record'. Ling Yuan's warning three months ago coiled in his heart like a venomous snake, impossible to shake. He knew he had to find his sister Chen Nian before that catastrophe arrived, find the key to changing his fate.

The Tianji Record Fragment in his arms grew slightly warm, that familiar burning sensation reminding him—the Heavenly Fate value was draining away. Chen Ji frowned but didn't stop his movements. He cut his fingertip, letting blood drip onto the ancient text. A pale golden light suddenly blazed, illuminating the entire quiet chamber. An odd power surged from the pages, like invisible threads extending toward some distant direction.

That was the pull of blood. Chen Ji's eyes snapped open as he felt a familiar, heart-stopping aura coming from a thousand miles away—it was Chen Nian! His sister! Ever since she was taken away by Holy Sect people five years ago, he had never felt this blood connection again. Now, that faint link was strengthening at an alarming rate, as if something was catalyzing her bloodline awakening.

Sudden hurried footsteps echoed outside the quiet chamber. Chen Ji frowned, tucked away the ancient text, and vanished into the shadows in a flash. The visitor was Su Qingyao, the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, holding a secret letter in her hands, her expression grave. Her footsteps stopped at the door, but she didn't knock immediately, as if hesitating. 'Chen Ji, I know you're in there.' Her voice was low and serious, 'Sect Master Ling Yuan summons all Inner Disciples to the Council Hall immediately.'

dialogue.content: (Su Qingyao stood outside the door, her tone carrying a hint of concern) 'Your recent actions have been too conspicuous. The commotion at the scripture library that day has already drawn the attention of the Law Enforcement Hall. Sect Master Ling Yuan... I always feel he has ulterior motives regarding you. If you don't want to go, I can cover for you.'

text.content: Chen Ji's heart warmed, but he shook his head. He appreciated Su Qingyao's kindness, but he couldn't leave now—the blood resonance was growing stronger, as if something significant was about to happen any moment. He pushed open the door, facing this Inner Disciple Senior Fellow whose attitude toward him had become increasingly subtle, a faint smile curling on his lips: 'Su Senior Sister, I remember your kindness, but there are some things I must handle personally.'

Before the words even finished, Chen Ji's body shuddered violently. A burning power exploded from his heart, like a volcano dormant for a thousand years suddenly erupting. It was blood resonance! The connection between him and Chen Nian was completely established at this moment, a mighty stream of information flooding into his Mental Sea like a bursting dam. Pain, searing heat, countless fragmented images flickered past like a carousel.

Chen Ji fell to his knees, clutching his head, veins bulging on his forehead. Su Qingyao cried out in alarm, about to step forward and help him, but he waved her off. 'Don't... don't come over!' Chen Ji's voice was hoarse and agonized, because he saw—in those chaotic images, one scene was crystal clear: on a majestic peak, a man in blue robes was confronting a dragon entirely golden in color.

That man in blue robes was none other than his father—Chen Xuan! The memory images seemed to be adjusted by an invisible hand, gradually becoming clearer. Chen Xuan knelt on one knee, facing that sky-covering dragon, his expression solemn. 'Dragon Vein Guardian, my Chen family swears with our bloodline, generation after generation we shall guard this seal, only asking that you grant us power so that my son may one day...'

dialogue.content: (Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul suddenly emerged from the Tianji Record Fragment, his voice old and urgent) 'Danger! The blood resonance has triggered the Dragon Vein Covenant's memory seal! Chen Ji, you must stabilize your mind, otherwise this wave of memory impact will explode your Mental Sea! Remember, what you see is not illusion, but the truth flowing through your bloodline!'

text.content: Chen Ji gritted his teeth, forcefully suppressing the surging information stream. The memory images continued—the golden dragon's low voice echoed through the valley: 'Chen family descendant, I see your sincerity. I am willing to make a blood covenant with you. Your descendants will inherit the Dragon Vein power, but must also bear the Dragon Vein tribulation. After ten thousand years, if a descendant can gather the Tianji Record and awaken my remnant soul, only then can the seal be completely lifted.'

The scene shifted, and Chen Ji saw a baby girl being brought before Chen Xuan. The infant had a pale golden mark between her brows, identical to the one on his chest. Chen Xuan, with tears in his eyes, entrusted the girl to a mysterious figure, whispering: 'Niannian is a born Dao body, her bloodline contains the key to awakening the Dragon Vein. The Holy Sect will eventually discover her uniqueness. I must hide her away.'

So that's how it is! Chen Ji finally understood everything. His sister Chen Nian was not taken by the Holy Sect, but arranged by their father to live under a false name in the mortal world, solely to avoid those who coveted the Dragon Vein power. Yet fate played a cruel trick—five years ago, the Holy Sect still found her. Chen Ji clenched his fists tightly, nails digging deep into his palms, blood dripping to the ground.

The blood resonance continued, another image flooding into Chen Ji's Mental Sea. This time, he saw Chen Nian—a young woman in plain white robes, trapped in a dark stone chamber. Her hands were bound by golden chains, the mark between her brows glowing faintly, clearly undergoing some kind of ritual. Her lips moved slightly, as if calling out to someone.

dialogue.content: (Chen Nian's voice came like a wisp of silk, trembling with sobs) 'Brother, is that you? I feel you. Did you come for me? I'm so scared... They want to use my blood to open something. I heard them mention the 'Heavenly Dao's Eye'... Brother, save me...'

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes instantly moistened. Five years. countless times he had imagined reuniting with his sister, never imagining she was enduring such suffering. That power within his bloodline seemed to sense his emotions, burning like fire on oil, blazing fiercely. The mark on his chest glowed dazzlingly, and the True Qi within his body began surging wildly.

At this moment, a majestic and ancient voice suddenly rang within Chen Ji's bloodline, like an ancient bell shaking his very soul. 'Chen family descendant... I sense your bloodline is awakening. Ten thousand years have passed. I have finally waited for a descendant worthy of inheriting the Dragon Vein power.' That voice was low and vast, carrying undeniable majesty, 'Are you the one destined?'

choice.prompt: How should Chen Ji respond to the Dragon Vein Guardian's inquiry? The power of blood surged within him, Chen Nian's plea still echoed in his ears, while in the distance Su Qingyao anxiously watched his every move. At this moment, the gears of destiny began to spin faster.

choices.text: Accept the call of Dragon Vein power with composure
choices.description: Chen Ji took a deep breath, speaking calmly to that voice: 'I am Chen Ji, son of Chen Xuan. I am willing to inherit the Dragon Vein power, only asking to save my sister.' The blood resonance reached its peak at this moment.
choices.visible_reward: Bloodline awakening degree greatly increased, Dragon Vein power initially unsealed
choices.risk_hint: May trigger internal upheaval in Tianqing Sect, alerting Ling Yuan to the anomaly

text.content: As Chen Ji's words fell, a majestic force that could suffocate burst forth from the depths of his bloodline, like thousands of golden dragons surging through his body. It was the Dragon Vein Power—the legacy of the ancient dragon race—integrating into his flesh, bones, and meridians in an不可思议 manner. Pain and power arrived simultaneously. Chen Ji threw back his head in a long howl, his voice carrying an unmistakable hint of dragon's roar.

choices.text: Refuse the Dragon Vein Guardian's test
choices.description: Chen Ji coldly said: "I am Chen Ji, but I don't need you to define my fate. I only want to save my sister. As for the Dragon Vein Power, I will find it myself." The power in his bloodline instantly dimmed somewhat.
choices.visible_cost: Dragon Vein Power's recognition has decreased
choices.visible_reward: Maintain independent judgment,不被mysterious力量左右
choices.risk_hint: May provoke the Dragon Vein Guardian, lose part of bloodline inheritance

text.content: The majestic voice fell silent for a moment, then let out a meaningful light laugh: "Interesting... You are indeed more principled than your father. Very well, I shall watch how you walk your own path. But remember, the blood pact of the Chen family has already taken effect. You can refuse the power, but you cannot refuse the responsibility." As the voice faded, the burning sensation in the bloodline eased slightly, but that deep connection still remained.

choices.text: Explore more truth about the bloodline
choices.description: Chen Ji did not rush to respond, but calmly asked: "Dragon Vein Guardian, what is this seal you speak of? What is the Heavenly Eye? I need to know the entire truth." The resonance of the bloodline became more stable under his guidance.
choices.visible_cost: Consume more Heavenly Fate Value to maintain deep resonance
choices.visible_reward: Obtain valuable intelligence about the ancient seal and Heavenly Eye
choices.risk_hint: Deep resonance may damage divine consciousness, and may be detected by Ling Yuan

text.content: A hint of appreciation entered the Dragon Vein Guardian's voice: "You truly understand strategic planning better than your father. Very well, I shall tell you some truth—ten thousand years ago, the Heavenly Eye descended, intending to devour this world's origin to sustain itself. At that time, the great powers joined forces to seal it in the depths of the Void. And the key to this seal is... the Dragon Vein! The Chen family is the bloodline that guards this key!"

No matter what choice Chen Ji made, the resonance of the bloodline could not be completely severed. The torrent of power might have temporarily subsided, but that sense of bloodline connection became unprecedentedly clear. He could feel Chen Nian's fear and despair at this moment, and also sense that the seal in the distant Holy Sect was gradually loosening due to her bloodline awakening.

Su Qingyao stood nearby, witnessing all this firsthand. Her eyes were full of shock and disbelief—this worthless disciple who was usually cowardly and incompetent, the aura emanating from him now even made her, an Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, feel palpitations. She opened her mouth, wanting to say something, yet not knowing where to begin. In the end, she simply walked gently to Chen Ji's side and draped a robe over his shoulders.

Chen Ji raised his head, looking at Su Qingyao's worried gaze, and a bitter smile curved his lips. He knew that from this moment on, his fate had fundamentally changed. Dragon Vein Power, Heavenly Eye, ten thousand year seal... these things that originally only existed in legends were now connected to his bloodline. And his sister Chen Nian stood at the center of this storm, waiting for his rescue.

He slowly stood up, his gaze firm as iron. Ling Yuan's warning, the bloodline awakening, his sister's cries for help—all of this told him that time was running out. The Corpse Bone Anomaly three months later might be the precursor of the Heavenly Eye breaking its seal. He must become stronger before then, strong enough to take back Chen Nian from the Holy Sect, strong enough to change that destined fate.

The Dragon Vein Guardian's voice rang out once more from the depths of the bloodline, the low and majestic tone carrying a hint of anticipation: "Chen family descendant, I have waited ten thousand years for you. The path ahead, see how you choose. Remember, the pride of the dragon race flows in your bloodline. No matter which path you choose, do not disgrace this inheritance." As the voice faded, that connection gradually dimmed, leaving only a faint trace of a mark, engraved in Chen Ji's heart.
